text:
maria: :wave: Quick heads-up — doing a small reshuffle for tomorrow's RFC review (11:00am PT). Need to move a couple authors, add a perf pre-read item, and confirm reviewers.

raj: Which RFCs are we talking about?

maria: RFC-191 (model routing), RFC-198 (kv-cache eviction), RFC-203 (quantization ops). Links: https://redwood.dev/rfc/191 , https://redwood.dev/rfc/198 , https://redwood.dev/rfc/203

kevin: I can swap into the 11:00 slot if someone takes 11:30. @sophia are you still ok to cover RFC-198?

sophia: yep I can review RFC-198. Can someone drop the perf numbers into the pre-read? I want to validate token throughput assumptions. :eyes:

maria: good call. @sophia I'm adding a short perf appendix to the pre-read. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.internal/rfc-pre-reads/perf-appendix.md

lee: slight timezone ask — can we move RFC-203 earlier? author (Ana) is in CET and prefers earlier.

ana (note: we should use ana): ana: I can do 10:45am PT (earlier is fine) — that avoids late evening for me.

maria: ok proposed new ordering:
```
10:45am PT - RFC-203 (quant ops) - author: ana
11:00am PT - RFC-191 (model routing) - author: raj
11:30am PT - RFC-198 (kv-cache eviction) - author: kevin
```

raj: 11:00 still works for me. who will lead the discussion for RFC-191?

kevin: I can lead RFC-198 discussion. For RFC-191 I suggest @maria or @raj to lead, with a 10min deep-dive and 10min Q&A.

maria: I'll lead 191. Also adding a 5-min "regressions / canary checks" item to the perf appendix per @sophia.

sophia: thanks — I'll compile quick checklist: perf smoke, latency p50/p95, token-cost delta.

raj: tiny ask: can we get reviewers to at least skim pre-reads by EOD today? makes the meeting useful.

maria: agreed. Sending a reminder now.

calendar-bot: Reminder set — RFC review meeting updated. 10:45am PT start, agenda attached. Attendees: maria, raj, kevin, sophia, lee, ana.

maria: final check — does anyone object to the new order or timing? otherwise I'll update the invite and post the pre-read summary. :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup: no objections.

lee: no objections.

ana (typo corrected): ana: all good from me, thanks for accommodating the timezone.

maria: cool — invite updated and pre-read summary posted: https://docs.redwood.internal/rfc-pre-reads/summary-2067890123.md

raj: I'll skim and flag anything critical tonight. If something needs deeper follow-up we can table it for design triage.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.
